findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_allowances, get_allowances_by_location, get_allowances_by_postcode, search_perdiem, get_perdiem_allowance, get_perdiem_allowance_by_location, get_perdiem_allowance_by_postcode, get_dssr_locations, get_countries, get_country, get_dssr_locations_by_country, get_gsa_perdiem_by_state_year · Private data: get_user · Public sink: get_allowances, get_allowances_by_location, get_allowances_by_postcode, search_perdiem, get_perdiem_allowance, get_perdiem_allowance_by_location, get_perdiem_allowance_by_postcode, get_dssr_locations, get_country, get_dssr_locations_by_country, cola_calculator_by_postcode, get_zipcode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_allowances, get_allowances_by_location, get_allowances_by_postcode, search_perdiem, get_perdiem_allowance, get_perdiem_allowance_by_location, get_perdiem_allowance_by_postcode, get_dssr_locations, get_countries, get_country, get_dssr_locations_by_country, get_gsa_perdiem_by_state_year · Private data: get_user · Public sink: get_allowances, get_allowances_by_location, get_allowances_by_postcode, search_perdiem, get_perdiem_allowance, get_perdiem_allowance_by_location, get_perdiem_allowance_by_postcode, get_dssr_locations, get_country, get_dssr_locations_by_country, cola_calculator_by_postcode, get_zipcode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
